measures.label: Total waiting list (incomplete pathways)
measures.definition: Patients waiting to start treatment at month end. Sum of Part_2 across all weekly bands.
measures.caveat: Sum of submitted data only. NHS England's national headline may include estimates for organisations that did not submit, so it can be higher.

measures.label: Waiting with a decision to admit
measures.definition: Incomplete pathways where a decision to admit for treatment has been made (Part_2A).

measures.label: Share of the waiting list awaiting admission
measures.definition: waiting_list_dta / waiting_list_total x 100.

measures.label: Percentage waiting 18 weeks or less
measures.definition: Part_2 patients in bands with weeks_upper <= 18, divided by waiting_list_total, x 100.

measures.label: Waiting more than 18 weeks
measures.definition: Part_2 patients in bands with weeks_lower >= 18.

measures.label: Waiting more than 52 weeks
measures.definition: Part_2 patients in bands with weeks_lower >= 52.

measures.label: Waiting more than 65 weeks
measures.definition: Part_2 patients in bands with weeks_lower >= 65.

measures.label: Waiting more than 78 weeks
measures.definition: Part_2 patients in bands with weeks_lower >= 78.

measures.label: Waiting more than 104 weeks
measures.definition: Part_2 patients in the open-ended top band (more than 104 weeks).

measures.label: Median wait (weeks)
measures.definition: 50th percentile of the Part_2 waiting-time distribution, by linear interpolation within the weekly band containing the median patient. Same method as NHS England (matched exactly for all providers and specialties, September 2026). Rounded to 1 decimal place.

measures.label: 92nd percentile wait (weeks)
measures.definition: 92nd percentile of the Part_2 waiting-time distribution, interpolated as for the median. If it falls in the open-ended top band, the band's lower bound (104) is returned. Same method as NHS England (matched exactly, September 2026). Rounded to 1 decimal place.

measures.label: Approaching 52 weeks
measures.definition: Part_2 patients waiting more than 40 and up to 52 weeks. Will exceed 52 weeks within 12 weeks unless treated or removed.

measures.label: New RTT periods (clock starts)
measures.definition: Pathways starting in the month (Part_3). Published as a total with no waiting-time split.

measures.label: Completed pathways, admitted
measures.definition: Pathways ending with admission for treatment in the month (Part_1A), including unknown clock start.

measures.label: Completed pathways, non-admitted
measures.definition: Pathways ending in the month without admission (Part_1B), including unknown clock start.

measures.label: Completed pathways, total
measures.definition: clock_stops_admitted + clock_stops_non_admitted.

measures.label: Admitted pathways completed within 18 weeks
measures.definition: Part_1A patients in bands with weeks_upper <= 18, divided by Part_1A with a known clock start, x 100.

measures.label: Non-admitted pathways completed within 18 weeks
measures.definition: As above for Part_1B.

measures.label: Median wait of admitted completed pathways (weeks)
measures.definition: Median of the Part_1A distribution (known clock starts), interpolated within weekly bands.

measures.label: Median wait of non-admitted completed pathways (weeks)
measures.definition: Median of the Part_1B distribution (known clock starts), interpolated within weekly bands.

measures.label: Change in waiting list since previous month
measures.definition: waiting_list_total minus the previous month's, as published. Null if the previous month is not loaded or the organisation/specialty does not appear in it.
measures.caveat: Affected by providers missing a submission or being recoded. Use waiting_list_change_mom_like_for_like to see the underlying change.

measures.label: Change in 52+ week waiters since previous month
measures.definition: waiting_over_52_weeks minus the previous month's, as published.
measures.caveat: Affected by missing submissions and recoding; see the like-for-like version.

measures.label: Change in waiting list since previous month, like-for-like providers
measures.definition: Change in waiting_list_total counting only providers that submitted in both months.
measures.caveat: Providers recoded under a new ODS code, or merged into another provider, are treated as different providers until ODS successor mapping is applied. A merger inflates this measure: in July 2026 North Bristol (RVJ, about 42,000 waiting) stopped reporting and University Hospitals Bristol and Weston (RA7) grew from 50,605 to 94,932, so the July like-for-like change is overstated by roughly that amount.

measures.label: Change in 52+ week waiters since previous month, like-for-like providers
measures.definition: Change in waiting_over_52_weeks counting only providers that submitted in both months.

measures.label: Derived unreported completed pathways and removals
measures.definition: Previous month's waiting list + clock_starts - clock_stops_total - this month's waiting list, from published totals. Matches NHS England's "Derived unreported completed pathways and removals" (without estimates).
measures.caveat: Not a count of patients removed without treatment: it also reflects validation removals, pathways starting and stopping within the month, unreported additions, and providers missing a submission. See unreported_removals_like_for_like.

measures.label: Derived unreported completed pathways and removals, like-for-like (experimental)
measures.definition: Previous month's waiting list + clock_starts - clock_stops_total - this month's waiting list, counting only providers that submitted in both months. A positive value means the list fell by more than recorded treatment explains.
measures.caveat: Experimental and easily misread. Reflects validation removals (patients who no longer need treatment, duplicates), pathways that start and stop within the month, transfers between organisations and data quality. It is not a count of patients removed without treatment. Most meaningful at national and ICB level, and for trends rather than single months.

measures.label: Providers submitting
measures.definition: Number of providers with any rows in the group for the month.

views.label: England
views.description: All providers and commissioners in England (org_code ENG).

views.label: Provider
views.description: Where patients are treated. One row per provider (NHS trust or independent sector provider).

views.label: Provider's ICB
views.description: Providers grouped by their parent ICB as published. Answers "how are the providers in this ICB doing?".

views.label: Population (ICB)
views.description: Patients grouped by the ICB responsible for commissioning their care, wherever they are treated. Answers "how long are this ICB's residents waiting?". Includes patients treated by providers outside the ICB, and excludes other ICBs' patients treated inside it. Care commissioned directly by NHS England (for example specialised commissioning hubs) has no parent ICB and is grouped under org_code NHSE.

views.label: Population (sub-ICB location)
views.description: As population_icb, at sub-ICB location (former CCG) level.

caveats.text: All measures exclude patients commissioned outside England (commissioner code NONC: Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland, overseas), matching NHS England's published figures. In September 2026 this was 30,641 waiting-list pathways, weighted towards long waits.

Figures are sums of submitted data and do not include NHS England's estimates for providers that did not submit. National headline figures in NHS England's press notice do include estimates, so they can be higher (7.38m vs 7.07m waiting, September 2026). Medians and 92nd percentiles in the press notice exclude estimates and match ours.

new_non_submitters only detects providers that stopped submitting since the previous month. Providers missing for longer are listed in NHS England's press notice and will be detected once ODS reference data defines the expected set of providers.
Independent sector providers appear as providers in their own right. Totals by NHS trust exclude NHS-funded activity delivered by independent providers unless they are included explicitly.
Figures can be revised in later publications. This API keeps every vintage; the default view returns the latest revised figure. Use the as_published view for the figure as first released.

Some organisations do not submit for some months (for example after an electronic patient record go-live). Missing data are not zeros; national totals in the source may include estimates for non-submitters. Organisation-month caveats are listed here as they are identified.
